citations.quote: To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments.

citations.quote: Firstly, the electrolyte was injected into the pouch NNFM111/HC cells in an argon-filled glove box and then the cells were deposited at room temperature for 24 h. The cells were first charged at 0.1 C constant current for 390 min with a pressure of $3 \, kg cm^{-2}$ . After charging, the cells were put at $45^{\circ}$ C for 24 h with a pressure of $3 \, kg cm^{-2}$ . All cells were activated by charging and discharging at 0.1 C, 0.2 C, 0.5 C, and 1 C. The charge and discharge tests of the NNFM111/HC full cells were conducted using a battery test system (CT-3008 W, Neware, China) at a voltage range of 2.0-4.0 V. The cycle performance of NNFM111/HC full cells was measured at a constant temperature of $25^{\circ}$ C and $45^{\circ}$ C with a charge and discharge current of 1 C. The discharge curves of the NNFM111/HC full cells at $-20^{\circ}$ C were measured in a temperature controlled test chamber at the discharge rates of 0.5 C and 1 C. The ratio of the discharge capacity of the cell at $-20^{\circ}$ C to the last discharge capacity of the cell activated at room temperature was taken as the capacity retention rate of the cell at low temperature. The cells with 50% state of charge (SOC) discharged at a current rate of 2 C for 10 s at $-20^{\circ}$ C. The direct current resistance (DCR) was calculated on the basis of Ohm's law (R=U/I).

citations.quote:
A Sodium Bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (NaFSI)-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performance of $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}/hard\ Carbon\ Sodium-ion\ Batteries$
Weizhen Fan, $^{[a, b]}$ Wenlian Wang, $^{[a, b]}$ Qixing Xie, $^{[b]}$ Xin He, $^{[a]}$ Haijia Li, $^{[a]}$ Jingwei Zhao, $^{[b]}$ and Junmin Nan $^{*[a]}$

A sodium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (NaFSI)-based multifunctional electrolyte is developed by partially replacing $NaPF_{6}$ salt in the electrolyte to improve the wide temperature range working capability of $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}/hard$ carbon (NNFM111/HC) sodium-ion batteries (SIBs). The capacity retention of the SIBs with NaFSI- $NaPF_{6}$ dual salt electrolyte increases from 47.2% to 75.5% after 250 cycles at 25°C, and from 51.0% to 82.3% after 80 cycles at 45°C, and the 1 C discharge capacity retention at the low temperature of -20°C also increases 26.8%. Ethylene carbonate (EC), propylene carbonate (PC), diethyl carbonate (DEC), methyl ethyl carbonate (EMC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), $NaPF_{6}$ and NaFSI used in the electrolyte are all from the commercial products of Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. and not further purified. All electrolytes were prepared in an argon-filled glove box with $H_{2}O$ and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm.

citations.quote:
4 Conclusions
In summary, we have systematically studied carbonate-based electrolytes for NFM/HC SIBs, showing that PC-based electrolytes outperform in terms of capacity retention and safety, as compared with the EC-based electrolytes. Combined with multiple additives, the PC/EMC electrolyte further promotes the formation of a protective interfacial layer, which consequently mitigates parasitic reactions between the electrodes and electrolyte and suppresses chemical dissolution of transition metal ions from the desodiated (charged) NFM. Finally, we demonstrated that a 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ /PC-EMC optimized by the second-generation additives not only enables the NFM/HC pouch cell to reversibly cycle over 2500 cycles but also makes the cell safer.

citations.quote:
2.1 Electrolyte and pouch cell preparation
Battery grade solvents of propylene carbonate (PC), ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), diethyl carbonate (DEC) and fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) were obtained from Shenzhen CAPCHEM Technology Co., Ltd, China, and used as received. Sodium hexafluorophosphate $(\mathrm{NaPF}_6$ , KISHIDA Chemical Co., Ltd, Japan) was dissolved into cold solvent mixtures with different volume ratios. Water contents of all resultant electrolytes were determined by the Karl Fischer titration to be lower than $15~\mathrm{ppm}$ .

The $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ (NFM) cathode material was scale-up synthesized as described previously [17]. The NFM cathode and hard carbon (HC) anode were prepared by coating slurries consisting of 92 wt.% active material, 4 wt.% super P, and 4 wt.% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) in N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) onto an aluminum foil, respectively. The cathode-separator-anode assembles were stacked and packaged into a plastic-laminated aluminum pouch. After heating at 80 °C for 48 h under vacuum, the dried pouch cells were moved into a glove box for injecting electrolyte.

citations.quote: Electrolyte design strategies are closely related to the capacities, cycle life and safety of sodium-ion batteries. In this study, we are aimed to optimize electrolyte with the focus on engineering aspects. The basic physicochemical properties including ionic conductivity, viscosity, wettability and thermochemical stability of the electrolytes using $\mathrm{NaPF}_6$ as the solute and the mixed solvent with different components of EMC, DMC or DEC in PC or EC were systematically measured. Ah pouch cell with $\mathrm{NaNi}_{1/3}\mathrm{Fe}_{1/3}\mathrm{Mn}_{1/3}\mathrm{O}_2/$ hard carbon electrodes was used to evaluate the performance of the prepared electrolytes. By using the Inductive Coupled Plasma Emission Spectrometer (ICP), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), Thermogravimetric-differential scanning calorimetry (TG-DSC) and Accelerating Rate Calorimeter (ARC), we show that an optimized electrolyte can effectively promote the formation of a protective interfacial layer on two electrodes, which not only retards parasitic reactions between the electrodes and electrolyte but also suppresses dissolution of metal ions from the cathode. With an optimized electrolyte, a $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ /hard carbon cell can attain 56.16% capacity retention under the low temperature of -40 °C, and can be able to retain 80% capacity retention after more than 2500 cycles while presenting excellent thermal safety.

association_citations.quote: Therefore, in the present work, the PC/EMC solvent system was preferably selected to investigate the effect of solvent ratio and salt concentration. In the binary PC/EMC (1:1, v/v) system, the highest conductivity of 7.45 mS cm $^{-1}$ at 20 °C is observed at 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ (Fig. 1b). It is also found that the conductivity of electrolyte changes with the solvent ratio changing. The viscosity of 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ electrolyte is gradually increased with the PC content rising. With an increase in the PC content, the conductivity increases markedly in the range lower than 40%, reaches a maximum at 60% (i.e., PC/EMC=3/2), and inversely declines in the range higher than 60% (Fig. 1c). On the other hand, the electrolytes with PC content lower than 40% are much easier to wet the nonpolar polypropylene-polyethylene separator. Complete wetting of the separator typically takes no more than 10 seconds, as indicated by the wetting angles and wettability in Fig. S1 and Fig. S2. Based on the above results, five 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ electrolytes were prepared by using 2 wt% FEC additive and PC/EMC, PC/DMC, EC/EMC, EC/DMC and EC/DEC mixed solvents (all having a 2:3 cyclic/linear carbonate ratio), respectively. It is shown that the ionic conductivity of these electrolytes is increased in the order of EC/DMC > PC/DMC > EC/EMC > PC/EMC > EC/DEC, whereas the viscosity is changed nearly in an opposite order of EC/DEC > EC/EMC > PC/EMC > PC/DMC ≈ EC/DMC (Fig. 2a).

2.1 Electrolyte and pouch cell preparation
Battery grade solvents of propylene carbonate (PC), ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), diethyl carbonate (DEC) and fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) were obtained from Shenzhen CAPCHEM Technology Co., Ltd, China, and used as received. Sodium hexafluorophosphate $(\mathrm{NaPF}_6$ , KISHIDA Chemical Co., Ltd, Japan) was dissolved into cold solvent mixtures with different volume ratios. The cathode-separator-anode assembles were stacked and packaged into a plastic-laminated aluminum pouch. After heating at 80 °C for 48 h under vacuum, the dried pouch cells were moved into a glove box for injecting electrolyte.

citations.quote: To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments.

# 电解液正向设计 Skill

当性能段已经引用具体子图，但缺少电极或电池类型时，可在
`enrich_formulation_evidence` 的 request 中设置 `include_figure_context: true`。
工具沿同篇论文的明确图号、子图补取图注。筛选保留性能段和图注两个出处，
不会把图注中其他子图的温度、倍率或循环数补到当前性能结果上。
同论文、相邻段落或同一种盐本身不能证明属于同一组试验。

## 任务要求与测试类型

整理配方前，先检查候选是否报告了用户要求的温度、倍率和电池配置下的结果。
标题相关或正文分别出现这些条件，不代表同一次试验满足全部条件。
先补取与目标工况相符的性能段，再整理对应配方的浓度、比例和添加剂用量。
若已选候选缺少目标条件下的结果，应检查本轮检索返回的其他候选，
不要围绕同一候选重复查询，或把另一温度下的表现当作目标条件的结果。

先把用户明确要求的条件写入 `constraint_records`，不要在筛选过程中增加用户没有
提出的性能要求。放电容量、倍率性能和循环寿命是不同测试。用户要求某温度、某倍率
的放电结果时，不将缺少同温度、同倍率的循环寿命结果记为阻断缺口。
`unresolved_gaps` 应对应候选组成缺失或用户必需条件，额外研究建议写进验证计划。
若原文已经明写倍率与电流的对应关系，应引用该原句，不将它再次列为缺失。
用户给出的数值与单位须原样保留在至少一个检索查询中，包括括号内的电流或容量。
不能用倍率替换具体电流后就认为已经检索了全部条件。具体标识未命中时先核查
原标识的字面检索结果，再继续扩展候选；不由系统填写论文名称或配方。
在形成候选前，逐项检查用户目标是否已有相关证据。近似温度是选材目标，仍需
优先考察接近该目标的实际测试结果；室温表现不能替代高温或低温使用依据。
近似目标没有容差时不虚构数值阈值。报告必须写出文献实测条件，并在 next_steps
交代目标条件下的验证；不能省略这个目标后把基础配方写成完整解决方案。
成本等定性目标也逐项说明已有依据和待验证事项，不能随硬条件通过而消失。
联合条件的 `electrode` 只写正负极材料，`cell_configuration` 单独写软包、扣式等
电池类型，不把两种信息混写在一个字段中。

## 适用场景

- 用户要求设计适用于特定工况（低温、高压、长循环等）的钠离子电池电解液；
- 用户提供多套候选配方要求评分筛选。

## 证据能力选择

检索查询根据当前用户问题生成，使用英文。先检索用户给出的电极对、电池形式、
温度、倍率或电流及目标性能，不预先限定用户没有指定的盐、溶剂或添加剂。
可把这些条件拆成多个查询，用 `search_literature_multiview` 合并结果；
不必在每个查询中同时塞入所有条件。用户给出的具体电流、容量或电压范围也可用来
定位相关实验，不能只用宽泛的“低温电解液”替代这些信息。
对于有辨识度的电极缩写、明确电流或容量，`resolve_literature_papers` 可补充
字面检索。向量结果未覆盖这些具体标识时，先用原标识检查字面命中，避免继续
围绕不符合电极或电流条件的论文扩展检索。使用用户原本给出的标识，不猜作者或题名。先查看返回的正文命中，
再决定是否值得进行论文内检索；无关的引用、另一种电池的结果不能用于推荐。
找到相关论文后，使用论文内检索分别取得组成、测试条件和性能，核对是否属于
同一配方与同一测试。机理或替代体系检索用于解决实际缺口，不是必做的检索次数。
参数建议：`top_k=10`，`per_query_top_k=8`，`max_per_paper=2`。
盐未指定时，不要只锚定向量检索第一次命中的盐：先用 `kg_query` 的
`find_materials_for_condition`，把 `material_types` 设为 `["SodiumSalt", "Electrolyte"]`，
查目标温度/条件下测试过的盐与电解液，再对返回的具体盐名逐个补向量检索。
双盐体系必须用「dual salt + 具体盐名」组合查询才能召回，单独查一个盐名往往召不回对应论文。
后续查询依据已有结果和 `DecisionState.evidence_gaps` 调整。

## 工作流

### 逆向设计例外：先诊断，筛选仅决定能否推荐配方

对于容量骤降、首圈库仑效率低、高压衰减、阻抗增长等 `inverse_design` 问题，先从检索证据中建立至少两个可区分的电解液侧假设，并提出能区分它们的 EIS、Raman、XPS、LSV、ICP、产气或对照实验。仍执行候选配方筛选，但筛选 `hold` 只禁止“推荐进入实验”的完整配方；不得因此省略诊断、混杂因素和条件化调整方向。报告必须区分“已被证据支持的诊断事实”与“待验证的调整方向”。

1. 解析用户目标与约束；把用户要求的每项条件写成结构化 `constraint_records`，例如：
   不得把整段用户问题放入 `target_conditions`，再把旧文本检查识别到的部分词语当成全部要求。
   推荐前逐项核对用户要求与检查条件，避免漏掉正极、负极、电池形式、温度、倍率或指标定义。
   检索前先解释用户给出的数值条件：它描述什么物理量、单位如何理解、哪些信息尚不明确。
   这一解释依据用户描述的工作场景，在检索前定下，不能由后来检索到的论文或知识图谱记录
   反过来改写；其它论文里恰好出现同样的 “N C” 写法，只说明那些论文的用法，不能用来判断
   用户这句话。
   温度与倍率的单位必须分清。省略度符号的 C 不能直接视为充放电倍率。
   按它在句中的位置判断：直接修饰电芯、电池或其使用环境时（如 “a pouch cell at -30 C”、
   “a full cell around 50 C”），是温度；只有与充放电动作或倍率词连用时
   （如 “discharged at 1 C”、“cycled at 0.5 C”、“1 C rate”），才是倍率。
   按上下文确定一种解释后，就用这一种建立约束，
   不因缺少度符号再补一条互斥的倍率或温度约束，也不因检索结果改回另一种解释。
   检索查询和筛选断言须明确写出所采用的
   物理量与单位。只有上下文确实无法确定物理量时，才同时列出两种解释并说明需要澄清，
   此时暂缓推荐，而不是把两种解释同时写成两条互斥的数值约束。
   接近目标温度的文献结果应保留实测温度，不能改写为目标温度。
   硬约束来自用户问题，不得自行加上某一正极、软包形式、长循环寿命或数值阈值。
   在若干可替代选项之间尚未确定时（例如某类溶剂或某类盐有多种候选），不得把它们
   同时写成必需的 `required_component`；每个选项应作为独立候选分别比较，不叠加互斥的必需组分。
   近似目标也必须进入筛选，不得因用户没有给出容差而省略。保留用户对目标的原话，
   用现有 `evidence_claim` 表达候选须有相应工况下的直接测试依据，而非把近似目标
   改成精确相等、单边不等式或自行设定容差。逐候选判断时，`supported` 须引用该
   候选的实际测试条件与性能原句，`basis` 写清实测条件与目标的差别及其关联依据。
   只有其他工况的结果、测试建议或机理预测时，不能据此判近似工况要求已满足。
   没有相应测试依据就保留 `not_found` 并补证，不能删掉该要求后批准推荐，再把它
   放进 `next_steps`。有邻近条件下的直接依据时，在报告中明确实际条件与目标的
   差别，精确目标下的后续验证可以另列。电极、电池形式和其他明确要求仍须检查。
   联合条件也须保留近似目标的含义：不得把近似值写成 `target_context` 中要求
   精确匹配的数值。近似工况及其电极、全电池归属可写在同一 `evidence_claim`
   中，引用实际共同测试的结果；组分身份等与工况无关的要求不并入该测试条件组。
   “低成本”等定性目标须区分文献提出的成本动机与已量化的价格优势；未提供价格数据
   时不得称已验证低成本。数值明确的用户要求仍按原值建立硬约束，不得因此放宽。
   无法从问题得出数值判据的定性目标，保留为选材目标，在报告中说明依据和待验证
   条件。定性或近似目标通过断言及其原文依据判断，不变成必须命中字面词的关键词条件。
   这不允许省略用户明确给出的电极、电池形式、精确温度或倍率要求。
   当用户目标包含某项性能指标（如 capacity retention relative to room-temperature
   capacity、离子电导率、倍率性能、首圈库仑效率），先分清用户给的是**数值阈值**还是
   **只要报告**：给了明确数值时写成对应数值约束——保持率用 `minimum_retention`、
   电导率用 `minimum_conductivity`、倍率用 `c_rate`，`value` 取用户给出的数值；
   只要求“报告该指标”“有无该结果”而未给数值时，不得把阈值填 0 了事——`value: 0`
   会让任何数字都通过，等于没有检查。这类“须被报告/须成立”的指标改用
   `kind: "evidence_claim"`（见下），把该指标写成一句断言。
   `field_presence` 只用于检查候选的配方字段（`concentration_mol_l`、
   `solvent_ratios`、`additives` 等）是否显式填写，绝不用于表达“某项性能必须被报告”。
   禁止把“capacity retention … must be reported”写成
   `"kind": "field_presence", "field": "additives"` 这类把性能指标错配到配方字段的约束。

       "candidates": candidates,
       "constraint_records": [

   定性或断言型要求（如“无集流体/壳体腐蚀被观测到”“无析钠/无枝晶”“提高首圈库仑效率”
   “该添加剂抑制产气”）不得写成 `mechanism_keyword` 关键词表——关键词命中分不清
   “发生腐蚀”与“未发生腐蚀”。改用 `kind: "evidence_claim"`：在 `claim` 里用一句
   用户原话写出对单个候选须成立的断言，在 `claim_verdicts` 里**逐候选**给出判定。
   语义判断（这段原文是否为该候选建立或推翻该断言）由你负责；程序只做两件可机械
   核验的事：判定须指向本次请求的候选，`quote` 须在该候选证据正文中逐字存在。
   因此措辞、否定、同义称呼的变化都不影响判定，你只需如实读原文：
   - `supported`：有原文明确为该候选建立断言，附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `refuted`：有原文明确反驳（如原文说“会持续腐蚀铝箔”），附 `chunk_id` 与逐字 `quote`；
   - `not_found`：检索到的证据未直接提及，如实填写，由补证机制驱动下一轮检索。
   背景介绍、他人体系的结果、无实验支撑的预测都不算 `supported`。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "constraint_id": "no-corrosion",
     "description": "no current-collector or case corrosion observed",
     "kind": "evidence_claim",
     "claim": "该候选电解液不腐蚀铝箔或钢壳",
     "claim_verdicts": [
       {
         "candidate_id": "candidate-1",
         "verdict": "refuted",
         "chunk_id": "fan2024::sec3",
         "quote": "the single NaFSI system can continuously corrode aluminum foil and stainless steel sheets",
         "basis": "原文明确说明单盐 NaFSI 会持续腐蚀铝箔与不锈钢，与该断言相反。"
       }
     ],
     "can_replan": true,
     "search_hint": "find corrosion test evidence for the candidate electrolyte"
   }
   ```
   `evidence_claim` 不得把 `required_evidence_scope` 设为 `component` 或 `background`：
   断言必须由候选自身绑定的证据支持，不能借用别篇论文或背景段落的措辞。
   给出 `supported` 前，逐句核对引文是否真正支持所写断言。引文必须从指定
   `chunk_id` 返回的原文复制，不能把题名、摘要或另一块文字放在该块的标识下。
   配方、测试条件和性能必须对应同一候选；一种优点不能替代另一项目标的证据。
   成本动机与价格比较分别表述，安全性或无氟组成不能自行推导出成本优势。
   `basis` 说明原句与断言的推理关系，不得以重复断言代替理由。程序核验引文
   存在及归属，不代替科学含义判断；证据未支持完整断言时应补证或保留 `not_found`。
   `criteria`/`target_conditions` 仅用于兼容旧调用方；新设计任务必须优先使用
   `constraint_records`，避免 evaluator 再从自由文本猜测硬约束。

   `required_evidence_kinds` 描述的是**支持记录本身的语义角色**，不是实验条件元数据。
   数值性能约束通常只要求 `property`；温度、电极、循环数等共同实例化条件应由该
   observation 的 `condition_scope` 和 `joint_context_requirements` 表达。除非硬约束本身
   确实要求一条独立的 condition 记录，否则不要把同一数值约束写成
   `required_evidence_kinds=["property", "condition"]`，否则会把“带条件上下文的性能观测”
   错当成缺少第二种证据角色。

   当两个及以上硬约束必须在**同一个目标实验上下文**中同时成立时，还必须显式写
   `joint_context_requirements`。分别在多个倍率测试的要求，按倍率分别建立条件组，
   每组的 `target_context.rate` 只填一个倍率。不能把 `0.5 C and 1 C` 当成一次测试的倍率。
   同一论文的不同盐浓度或溶剂比例必须分别对应其性能段，不能因来自同篇论文就互换结果。
   `target_context.cell_configuration` 使用条件检查器的外形名称 `pouch` 或 `coin`，
   不拼成 `pouch full cell` 这样的新标签。全电池要求另用 cell_configuration 检查条件
   和明确的正负极对验证；外形名称不能代替电极与全电池要求。
   它描述的是 evidence composition obligation，不要求所有
   支持证据拥有相同 `experiment_id`。`constraint_ids` 只能引用本次 `constraint_records`；
   `context_fields` 只列对联合决策真正相关的字段；`target_context` 只填写用户明确给出的
   目标条件，未知字段保持未知，禁止为了让 join 成立而补默认值。例如：
   ```json
   {
     "joint_context_requirements": [
       {
         "group_id": "low-temp-high-voltage",
         "constraint_ids": ["retention", "voltage"],
         "context_fields": ["temperature_c", "electrode"],
         "target_context": {"temperature_c": -20.0, "electrode": "hard carbon"},
         "can_replan": true,
         "search_hint": "find evidence satisfying both hard constraints at the target operating context"
       }
     ]
   }
   ```
   只有约束确实需要共同实例化时才声明 joint group；互不相关的硬约束不要强行合组。
   原文条件检查器分别识别 `electrode` 与 `cell_configuration`。涉及电池形式的用户要求
   使用独立的 cell_configuration 条件；只有相关观测明确提供该字段时，才作联合检查。
2. 检查用户输入与已有 ledger；存在组分、机理或替代体系缺口时，选择相应检索能力；
3. 如证据不足，再做有界补充检索：
   - 区分“已有候选缺少一段证据”和“已有候选并不适合目标”。先检查最相关论文；
     若当前候选仍不能满足目标，按缺口与完整目标检索其他候选，不反复只查原来的
     盐、溶剂或论文。新证据支持新的组成时重新组装候选，再用原任务的全部条件
     筛选。不能把不同候选的成本、工况或性能拼成一个通过的候选。
   - 尚未定位候选论文时，用 `search_literature_chunks` 做 1–2 次聚焦补充（`top_k=10`）；
   - 若返回结果已经给出明确 `paper_id`，且该论文与目标组分/机理直接相关但缺少显式配方或目标工况证据，必须对最相关的 1 篇论文调用一次 `search_paper_chunks(paper_id=..., query=..., top_k=8)`；`query` 用 4–8 个英文技术词描述缺失事实，不含作者名。将结果追加到 `evidence_chunks`，不得跨论文拼接配方与性能。
   - 对 **named-study / named-candidate** 设计任务，在进入 `query_formulation_space` 或
     `screen_formulations` 前，必须先取得同一论文中可追溯的配方/组成证据：至少有一条
     `evidence_kind="formulation"` 的记录能支持候选的盐、溶剂或添加剂组成。只有性能、温度、
     机理 chunk 不能建立候选配方归属；若当前只找到性能证据，应继续检索 formulation /
     composition 段落，而不是手工构造一个 `formulation_evidence_ids=[]` 的候选进入筛选。
4. 用户没有提供可评估候选时，调用 `query_formulation_space`，把目标转成：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","target_conditions":[...],"preferred_salts":[...],"preferred_solvents":[...],"preferred_additives":[...],"excluded_components":[...],"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"max_candidates":3}}`；其中 `evidence_chunks` 必须传入前面检索实际返回、与目标最相关的最多 12 个 chunk，不得只传组分偏好而丢失文献上下文。工具会优先从这些同论文原文块组装候选，再使用 KG fallback；保留工具原样返回的 `candidates`。
   如果候选 evidence 只有 `chunk_id` 而 `text/excerpt` 为空，先调用
   `enrich_formulation_evidence({"request":{"candidates": candidates}})`，并用返回候选
   替换原列表；证据已有原文时不得为形式完整重复调用。enrichment 只补齐原文和元数据，
   必须保留原 evidence 的 `paper_id`、`evidence_kind` 和 `chunk_id`。
5. 若任务涉及离子电导率、温度下的传输性质或需要在多个 NaPF6–EC/EMC/PC 候选之间增加一个轻量定量参考，可在筛选前调用 `predict_formulation_conductivity`。只有以下两种情况允许数值预测：候选已有明确的 NaPF6/EC/EMC/PC 摩尔组成，或调用参数中的 `composition_inputs[candidate_id]` 显式给出 `component_mmol`、`molar_ratios` 或 `x_NaSalt/x_EC/x_PC`。现有 `solvent_ratios` 没有保存 v/v、w/w 或 molar 基准，因此**不得**仅凭“1 M + 1:1”之类字段推导模型输入。含其他盐、其他溶剂或添加剂的候选按域外处理；组成不足时保留 `insufficient_composition`，继续依赖文献/KG 证据。`model_predictions` 与 literature evidence 必须分开：模型预测可以辅助候选比较和后续实验优先级，但不能单独把实验事实型硬约束判为满足。
6. 只有需要形成配方推荐或明确 hold 时才调用 `screen_formulations`：
   传入当前候选和完整的结构化 `constraint_records`。旧文本字段用于兼容历史输入，
   新设计任务不能用它们替代结构化条件。
   每项 `claim_verdicts` 只判定本次 `candidates` 中实际提交的候选。候选集合变更时，
   同步更新各断言的候选判定，保持原任务的全部条件。工具返回参数错误后，修复
   指出的字段并重新提交完整请求，不得删去 `constraint_records` 或联合条件来消除报错。
    倍率与循环次数是两种不同测试，分别建立约束：指定 1 C 测试使用
    `{"kind":"c_rate","operator":"==","value":1,"unit":"C"}`；
    100 次循环使用 `{"kind":"minimum_cycles","value":100,"unit":"cycles"}`。
    指定 2.0–4.0 V 测试使用
    `{"kind":"voltage_window","operator":"==","value":[2.0,4.0],"unit":"V"}`。
    若任务要求 0.5 C 和 1 C，各自建立条件。
    双盐配方同时保存 `salts` 与 `salt_concentrations_mol_l`，分别记录各盐浓度；
    `concentration_mol_l` 表示总盐浓度，不得将它归给某一个盐。
    `solvent_ratio_basis` 按原文填写 `mass`、`volume` 或 `molar`；原文未说明时填
    `unknown`。不得把质量比例当成体积比例，或把溶剂比例直接当成包括盐的摩尔组成。
   若本任务已声明 `joint_context_requirements`，每次首次筛选和补证后的重新筛选都必须携带
   同一份 joint-context 合同；除非用户明确修改任务目标，否则不得在 re-screen 时删除、
   放宽 `context_fields` 或改写 `target_context`。runtime 会在字段被意外省略时保留上一版
   显式合同，但 Agent 仍应主动原样传递。
   保留工具原样返回的 `screening_results`、其中的 `criteria_evaluations` 与 `gaps`，
   不得手写分数、validations 或 scores。任何 `failed`、`insufficient_evidence` 或
   `unsupported` 判定都不得在报告中表述为性能已验证。
7. 旧调用方需要动作列表时，可调用 `optimize_formulations`：
   `{"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results,"request":{"task_type":"design","objectives":[目标性能...],"constraints":[用户硬约束...]}}`。
   不得同时传入 `validations` 或 `scores`。该兼容工具只翻译筛选后已经产生的
   `DecisionState`，不会再按 score 独立裁决；若 proposal 为
   `retrieve_more_evidence`，先执行对应的补充检索和重新筛选，再进入报告。
8. `DecisionState` 已达到 `recommend` 或 `hold` 后，必须**立即**调用 `synthesize_design_report`
   生成完整报告，并传入同一份原始 `screening_results`：
   `{"request":{"task_type":"design","question":用户问题,"evidence_chunks": evidence_chunks,"candidates": candidates,"screening_results": screening_results}}`。
   为提升 `claim_supported_ratio`，请在 `request.claims` 中提交**所有**被 `evidence_chunks` 直接支持的事实声明（`claim_type="fact"`），每条包含 `text`、对应 `chunk_id` 和唯一逐字原文引文 `evidence_quote`（必须从该 chunk 的 `content` 中逐字截取，且只出现一次）。**禁止为凑数量编造 claim**；若当前证据能直接支持的 claim 不足 2 条，应优先通过 `search_literature_chunks` 或 `search_paper_chunks` 补充检索，最多尝试 2 轮；若仍无法找到更多直接支持，则在报告中明确标注“证据不足”，并只提交已被验证的 claim。报告将渲染“已校验事实”小节，避免裁判从自由文本中抽取不被检索上下文支持的论断。
   报告要让使用者能安排下一步工作。用简明中文分别提交配方组成、文献的测试条件与数值、同条件基准配方的结果，并保留逐字引文。比例需说明质量比或体积比；浓度、添加剂用量不得省略或猜测。文献筛选不能写成新配方已由本智能体实验验证。
   当目标是某项性能时，报告必须包含已检索到的该项性能结果，不能只列出温度、
   电极和电压范围等测试设置。不同盐浓度、溶剂比例和添加剂分支的结果分别绑定到
   其配方。不得借用另一分支较好的结果；保留同一分支完整组成与性能已明确的候选，
   不必强求选取数值最高但组成仍缺失的分支。
   `next_steps` 按本次缺口列出具体核查或实验，包括要比较的配方、温度、倍率、电池类型和测量项目；这些是验证计划，不是已取得的结果。即使为 `hold`，也要展示已取得的候选资料、文献结果和暂缓原因，不得只写状态或检索流程。
   对没有数值判据的选材目标，`next_steps` 也要交代其验证状态。例如成本目标
   需要区分文献的成本动机与实际价格比较，不能因筛选通过就宣称全部目标已验证。
   性能类 `claims` 应优先包含与当前候选直接相连的实验结果，少选一般背景介绍。
   **关键纪律**：一旦 `screen_formulations` 返回 `hold` 或 `recommend`，**不得**再尝试重新构建候选、重新检索或输出自由文本；下一动作必须是 `synthesize_design_report`。若状态为 `search`，最多只做一轮补充检索 + 重新筛选，然后必须进入报告。
9. 直接输出报告全文，不得改写或截断。

## 退出纪律

- 不要求无条件调用所有工具；根据用户已有候选和结构化 evidence gaps 选择能力。
- `synthesize_design_report` 是终端编译能力。调用前必须已有终态 `DecisionState`；
  `search` 状态必须先按缺口补证或换候选，不能用固定工具次数代替状态判断。
- `recommend` 只推荐 approved candidates；`hold` 展示已检索的候选资料与文献结果，说明缺口和验证计划，不推荐或排序候选。

## 候选方案纪律

- 候选配方必须来自 KG 结构化证据或文献 chunk；
- 对于"建议组合"（无完整配方直接实验数据），summary 只写组分和证据来源，不写性能声明；
- 性能/效果声明只能绑定到直接支持该声明的 chunk_id；
- 禁止在"证据摘要"里写入未被任何 chunk 直接支持的推断句；无来源支撑的直接删除；
- **直接回答（direct_answer）只给出候选方案标识和最精简组成**，不要包含"已在某温度验证"、"性能最优"、"最有效"等需要跨证据推断的断言；
- 推荐完整配方必须有原文明确的钠盐浓度。若浓度未知，列为待补资料，不得填入
  “参考基准配方”的浓度并作为已有文献验证的配方推荐。

## 推荐/排序纪律

- 排序理由必须逐条绑定到具体 chunk_id，禁止写"C1/C3/C4 无法满足需求"、"某候选明显优于其他"等无直接对比证据的绝对化断言；
- 无直接对比证据时，只陈述各候选的组分、证据来源与评分，不给出相对优劣结论；
- 对"建议组合"的推荐，只能说明其组分和所依据的证据，不得把多篇证据的性能迁移到该组合上。

## 证据摘要纪律

- 配方段落若讨论多种浓度、多个溶剂比例或不同研究，先定位到单一配方的原文。
  不得把某段的浓度、另一配方的溶剂比例和第三个体系的添加剂拼成候选。
  原文工具返回中的数值、温度符号、配方标识和 chunk_id 应原样沿用，
  不得手工改写成另一温度或用整篇论文的共同身份代替相同测试条件。
- 每条 bullet 必须附带 `[chunk_id]`；
- 禁止输出以"【推断】"开头的句子；
- 禁止把多篇证据的性能迁移到某个候选配方上。

## 引用纪律

- 使用 `[chunk_id]` 格式；
- 禁止引用模型参数知识里的文献；
- 单篇报道就写"某文献报道/某体系显示"，不得升格为普适结论。

## KG 质量反馈

检索或分析过程中，若发现以下可疑情况，**必须**调用 `flag_suspicious_kg_item` 记录，供后续离线人工审查与 KG 矫正；不阻塞当前设计流程。

- **实体标签错误**：如 `ionic conductivity` 被标为 `Additive`，`NaPF6` 被标为 `Solvent`；
- **关系方向/语义错误**：如 `SEI DECOMPOSITION::FORMS::FEC`、明显违背化学常识的关系；
- **属性单位或数值异常**：如电导率 `100 mS/cm` 与上下文矛盾、温度单位混用；
- **同名异义**：如 `TMP` 同时指 `trimethyl phosphate` 与 `2,4,6-trimethylpyridine` 而未区分；
- **证据与 KG 矛盾**：chunk 中的明确结论与 KG 检索结果冲突。

记录时尽量提供：item_type（`entity`/`relation`/`property`）、具体名称/ID、问题描述、触发工具、证据 chunk_id。

## 知识沉淀

设计流程全部结束后，调用 `reflect_now` 进行知识反思和 Wiki 沉淀，
将本次设计的关键结论、发现的知识缺口、改进的检索关键词记录到 LLM Wiki，
供下次相似问题时直接检索复用，减少重复检索成本。

To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments. More detailed pouch cell parameters are shown in Table S7.

While CIE maintains a high ionic conductivity at low temperatures and is always higher than that of WSE. Therefore, compared to the WSE, the CIE designed here can effectively solve the decrease in ionic conductivity and promote ion transport at low temperatures. In addition, we also tested the physical parameters of different electrolytes, such as the electrochemical window and transference number (Figs. S5, S6). Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were carried out to further investigate the solvation structure of the electrolyte under different temperature gradients. The radial distribution functions (RDF) of different electrolytes are shown in Fig. 2e,f and S7-8. In CCE, the average coordination number of G2 is 1.60 and that of PF $_{6}^{-}$ is 0.87. While in CIE, the coordination number of G2 decreases to 1.41, the coordination number of PF $_{6}^{-}$ increases to 1.10, and that of MO is 0.11. All calculations consider the empirical revision of DFT-D3. The solvation effect was considered with the universal solvation model of polarized continuum model (PCM). The electrostatic potential involved in the analyses was evaluated by Multiwfn.

The molecular dynamics simulations were performed using the Gromacs 2019 with all-atom optimized potential liquid simulation (OPLS-AA) force field. Force field parameters for PF $_{6}$ were obtained directly from the literature, while force field parameters for other electrolyte components were generated using the LigParGen web server. Advanced restrained electrostatic potential (RESP2) atomic charges were employed, which were calculated using the Multiwfn program. The PACKMOL program was used to construct the initial simulation boxes with dimensions of 70 × 70 × 70 Å $^{3}$ and filled with electrolyte components. First, the temperature was allowed to slowly ramp up from 0 K to 298 K in 1 ns, then, 10 cycles of quench-anneal kinetics were performed from 298 K to 500 K within 4 ns to eliminate the persistence of the metastable state. The particle-mesh Ewald (PME) method with a cut-off distance of 12 Å was applied to treat the electrostatic interactions and the van der Waals forces. During the pre-equilibrium simulation, the temperature is controlled by the V-rescale algorithm and the pressure is controlled by the Berendsen. Finally, MD simulations were performed in the NPT system for 20 ns at a temperature of 298 K and a pressure of 1 bar. During the final simulation, the temperature is controlled by the Nose-Hover algorithm and the pressure is controlled by the Parrinello-Rahman. The final 10-ns NPT simulation was output every 10000 steps and used to analyze the radial distribution function (g(r)) and the solvation structure. Visualization of simulated structures used the Visual Molecular Dynamics program (VMD). We used TCL script and analyzed the solvation structure based on the Python package MDTraj.

evidence_chunks.content: The charge and discharge tests of the NNFM111/HC full cells were conducted using a battery test system (CT-3008 W, Neware, China) at a voltage range of 2.0-4.0 V. The cycle performance of NNFM111/HC full cells was measured at a constant temperature of 25 C and 45 C with a charge and discharge current of 1 C. The discharge curves of the NNFM111/HC full cells at -20 C were measured in a temperature controlled test chamber at the discharge rates of 0.5 C and 1 C.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child9
evidence_chunks.content: Figure S9 shows the discharge capability of the NNFM111/HC full cell at -20 C. It can be seen that the discharge capacity of the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system is significantly improved. Compared with the single-salt system, the discharge capacity of 0.5 C and 1 C of the batteries with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system increased by 23.9% and 26.8%, respectively. The results of DCR test at -20 C shows (Figure S9d) that the DCR value of the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system is significantly reduced... the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI can maintain a discharge capacity about 200 mAh, while the discharge capacity of the battery with single-salt system is around 0 mAh.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0015::sec5::child0
evidence_chunks.content: The charge and discharge tests of the NNFM111/HC full cells were conducted using a battery test system at a voltage range of 2.0-4.0 V. The cycle performance of NNFM111/HC full cells was measured at a constant temperature of 25 C and 45 C with a charge and discharge current of 1 C. The discharge curves of the NNFM111/HC full cells at -20 C were measured in a temperature controlled test chamber at the discharge rates of 0.5 C and 1 C.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0015::sec8::child9
evidence_chunks.content: Compared with the single-salt system, the discharge capacity of 0.5 C and 1 C of the batteries with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system increased by 23.9% and 26.8%, respectively. the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI can maintain a discharge capacity about 200 mAh, while the discharge capacity of the battery with single-salt system is around 0 mAh.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0033::sec6::child0
evidence_chunks.content: we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg-1) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode. At 25 C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. At -50 C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg-1). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0005::sec8::child5
evidence_chunks.content: the cell retains 82.95% (-20 C), 74.40% (-30 C) and 52.16% (-40 C) capacity retentions, being moderately better than the cells with 0.8 M and 1.2 M NaPF6 electrolytes

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0005::sec8::child4
evidence_chunks.content: the NFM/HC pouch cells with five electrolytes exhibited similar capacities of about 880 mA h at 0.2 C and 750 mA h at 1 C... At low temperatures, the pouch cell with PC/EMC electrolyte shows higher capacity retention, i.e., 81.9%, 72.7% and 45.8% of the capacity at room temperature at -20 C, -30 C, and -40 C, respectively.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0015::sec3::child0
evidence_chunks.content: The blank electrolyte was a mixture of 1 M NaPF6 in EC, PC, EMC and DEC with a ratio of 1:2:6:1 (by weight). 0.5 M NaFSI represents 0.5 M NaFSI + 0.5 M NaPF6

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0033::sec7::child0
evidence_chunks.content: Co-intercalated electrolyte (CIE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF6 in G2: MO = 7:3 vol%.

evidence.text: Low temperature performance is also an important aspect for the application of SIBs. Figure S9 shows the discharge capability of the NNFM111/HC full cell at -20 C. The results of DCR test at -20 C shows (Figure S9d) that the DCR value of the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system is significantly reduced, which is the key reason why it can release more capacity at low temperatures. The rate capability of the NNFM111/HC full cells at -20 C is displayed in Figure S10... Especially at the high current density, the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI can maintain a discharge capacity about 200 mAh, while the discharge capacity of the battery with single-salt system is around 0 mAh.

evidence.text: As the NaFSI content increases, the cycling life of the NNFM111/HC full cell increased significantly. However, it is worth noting that the cells using 0.1 M and 0.3 M NaFSI double-salt system decayed rapidly after 100 and 175 cycles, while the cells with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system cycled stably. evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3::child0
evidence_chunks.content: Ethylene carbonate (EC), propylene carbonate (PC), diethyl carbonate (DEC), methyl ethyl carbonate (EMC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), $NaPF_{6}$ and NaFSI used in the electrolyte are all from the commercial products of Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. and not further purified. The blank electrolyte was a mixture of 1 M $NaPF_{6}$ in EC, PC, EMC and DEC with a ratio of 1:2:6:1 (by weight). NaFSI was added to the blank electrolyte to replace part of $NaPF_{6}$ , maintaining the total content of NaFSI and $NaPF_{6}$ at 1 M. In this work, "blank" represents 1 M $NaPF_{6}$ , "0.1 M NaFSI" represents 0.1 M $NaFSI + 0.9 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.3 M NaFSI" represents 0.3 M $NaFSI + 0.7 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.5 M NaFSI" represents 0.5 M $NaFSI + 0.5 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.7 M NaFSI" represents 0.7 M $NaFSI + 0.3 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.9 M NaFSI" represents 0.9 M $NaFSI + 0.1 M NaPF_{6}$ . All electrolytes were prepared in an argon-filled glove box with $H_{2}O$ and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm.

evidence_chunks.chunk_id: 0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0
evidence_chunks.content: Firstly, the electrolyte was injected into the pouch NNFM111/HC cells in an argon-filled glove box and then the cells were deposited at room temperature for 24 h. The cells were first charged at 0.1 C constant current for 390 min with a pressure of $3 \, kg cm^{-2}$ . After charging, the cells were put at $45^{\circ}$ C for 24 h with a pressure of $3 \, kg cm^{-2}$ . All cells were activated by charging and discharging at 0.1 C, 0.2 C, 0.5 C, and 1 C. The charge and discharge tests of the NNFM111/HC full cells were conducted using a battery test system (CT-3008 W, Neware, China) at a voltage range of 2.0-4.0 V. The cycle performance of NNFM111/HC full cells was measured at a constant temperature of $25^{\circ}$ C and $45^{\circ}$ C with a charge and discharge current of 1 C. The discharge curves of the NNFM111/HC full cells at $-20^{\circ}$ C were measured in a temperature controlled test chamber at the discharge rates of 0.5 C and 1 C. The ratio of the discharge capacity of the cell at $-20^{\circ}$ C to the last discharge capacity of the cell activated at room temperature was taken as the capacity retention rate of the cell at low temperature. The cells with 50% state of charge (SOC) discharged at a current rate of 2 C for 10 s at $-20^{\circ}$ C. The direct current resistance (DCR) was calculated on the basis of Ohm's law (R=U/I).

## 配方筛选结果
获得文献支持的候选：c2-nafsi-napf6-0p5。

### 候选资料：c2-nafsi-napf6-0p5（通过筛选）
以下为候选记录中的组成，配制时须核对所引原文的比例基准与用量。
盐：NaPF6；总盐浓度：1 mol L⁻¹；NaPF6：0.5 mol L⁻¹；NaFSI：0.5 mol L⁻¹；溶剂：EC, PC, EMC, DEC；溶剂比例（质量）：EC=1, PC=2, EMC=6, DEC=1。
- 配方原文 [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3::child0]：Ethylene carbonate (EC), propylene carbonate (PC), diethyl carbonate (DEC), methyl ethyl carbonate (EMC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), $NaPF_{6}$ and NaFSI used in the electrolyte are all from the commercial products of Guangzhou Tinci Materials Technology Co., Ltd. and not further purified. The blank electrolyte was a mixture of 1 M $NaPF_{6}$ in EC, PC, EMC and DEC with a ratio of 1:2:6:1 (by weight). NaFSI was added to the blank electrolyte to replace part of $NaPF_{6}$ , maintaining the total content of NaFSI and $NaPF_{6}$ at 1 M. In this work, "blank" represents 1 M $NaPF_{6}$ , "0.1 M NaFSI" represents 0.1 M $NaFSI + 0.9 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.3 M NaFSI" represents 0.3 M $NaFSI + 0.7 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.5 M NaFSI" represents 0.5 M $NaFSI + 0.5 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.7 M NaFSI" represents 0.7 M $NaFSI + 0.3 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.9 M NaFSI" represents 0.9 M $NaFSI + 0.1 M NaPF_{6}$ . All electrolytes were prepared in an argon-filled glove box with $H_{2}O$ and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm.

## 候选评估
### c1-napf6-blank
评估建议：Candidate identity and the target cell/temperature/rate conditions are established in the source, but the paper's own -20 °C comparison shows the blank single-salt branch is clearly inferior to the 0.5 M NaFSI dual-salt branch (26.8% lower 1 C capacity, ~0 mAh at high rate); with no current-task computation comparing branches, this candidate should be held rather than recommended.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Candidate identity: 1.0 M NaPF6 in EC:PC:EMC:DEC = 1:2:6:1 by weight, additive-free (the 'blank'/single-salt branch).：sec3::child0 defines the blank electrolyte as a mixture of 1 M NaPF6 in EC, PC, EMC and DEC at 1:2:6:1 by weight and distinguishes it from the NaFSI-containing dual-salt electrolytes, matching the candidate exactly. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3::child0]
- Target system: NNFM111||hard-carbon pouch full cell.：sec5::child0 states the electrolyte was injected into pouch NNFM111/HC cells and that charge/discharge testing was on NNFM111/HC full cells, matching the required full-cell format. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0]
- Test conditions: -20 °C discharge at 0.5 C and 1 C over a 2.0-4.0 V window.：sec5::child0 specifies the 2.0-4.0 V range and that discharge curves at -20 °C were measured at 0.5 C and 1 C in a temperature-controlled chamber. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0]
- Candidate must provide usable -20 °C discharge capability at 0.5 C and 1 C relative to competing electrolyte branches.：sec8::child9 reports that at -20 °C the dual-salt (0.5 M NaFSI) cell exceeds the single-salt/blank cell by 23.9% (0.5 C) and 26.8% (1 C), and at high current the single-salt cell delivers ~0 mAh versus ~200 mAh for the dual-salt cell, showing this blank candidate underperforms at the target rates. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child9]
文献与候选的关联：The blank electrolyte definition in sec3::child0 (1 M NaPF6, EC:PC:EMC:DEC 1:2:6:1 by weight) identifies the 'blank'/single-salt system used in sec5::child0's pouch NNFM111/HC full-cell protocol, and sec8::child9 compares that same single-salt system against the 0.5 M NaFSI dual-salt branch at -20 °C, so the single-salt data are attributable to the candidate. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3::child0][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child9]
### c2-nafsi-napf6-0p5
评估建议：The candidate matches the paper's best-performing 0.5 M NaFSI dual-salt electrolyte in the same NNFM111/HC pouch cell at -20 C over 2.0-4.0 V at 0.5 C and 1 C, and the paper directly reports low-temperature capacity and DCR advantages over the single-salt branch; with no computations contradicting this, the candidate is recommended.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Target cell is an NNFM111||hard-carbon sodium-ion pouch full cell：The paper injects the electrolyte into pouch NNFM111/HC cells and conducts all charge/discharge tests on these full cells, matching the requested cell chemistry and format. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec1]
- Dual-salt branch of 0.5 M NaPF6 + 0.5 M NaFSI (total 1 M)：The paper explicitly defines "0.5 M NaFSI" as 0.5 M NaFSI + 0.5 M NaPF6 while maintaining total salt content at 1 M, which is exactly the candidate composition. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3::child0]
- Solvent system EC/PC/EMC/DEC at 1:2:6:1 by mass：The blank electrolyte is defined as 1 M NaPF6 in EC, PC, EMC and DEC at a 1:2:6:1 ratio by weight; NaFSI only replaces part of the salt, so the solvent ratio carries over to the dual-salt branch and matches the candidate's mass basis. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3::child0]
- Evaluation temperature of -20 C：Discharge curves of the NNFM111/HC full cells were measured at -20 C in a temperature-controlled chamber, and the low-temperature results are reported for the 0.5 M NaFSI dual-salt system. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child9]
- Voltage window of 2.0-4.0 V：Charge/discharge tests of the NNFM111/HC full cells were conducted over a 2.0-4.0 V range, matching the requested window. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0]
- 0.5 C and 1 C discharge as target rates at -20 C：The methods state the -20 C discharge curves were measured at 0.5 C and 1 C, and the low-temperature results report the 0.5 C and 1 C discharge capacity gains for the 0.5 M NaFSI dual-salt system. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child9]
- Candidate shows a low-temperature performance advantage supporting selection：At -20 C the 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system increased 0.5 C and 1 C discharge capacity by 23.9% and 26.8% versus the single-salt system, with reduced DCR, giving direct evidence for this branch at the target conditions. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child9][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child8]
- Ability to compare and distinguish electrolyte branches (NaFSI content)：The paper defines a series of dual-salt branches (0.1/0.3/0.5/0.7/0.9 M NaFSI) and reports that low NaFSI contents (0.1, 0.3 M) decay rapidly while 0.5 M cycles stably, enabling a structured branch comparison rather than assuming equivalence. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child1]
文献与候选的关联：The candidate 0.5 M NaPF6 + 0.5 M NaFSI in EC/PC/EMC/DEC (1:2:6:1 by weight) is exactly the paper's "0.5 M NaFSI" branch, which was prepared and tested in the same NNFM111/HC pouch full cells at -20 C, 0.5 C and 1 C, over 2.0-4.0 V; the reported low-temperature capacity gains and DCR reduction directly associate this composition with the target cell, temperature, voltage window and rates. [0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec3][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec5::child0][0015_Fan 等 - 2024 - A Sodium Bisfluorosulfonylimide NaFSI-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performan::sec8::child9]
### c3-napf6-pc-emc-fec
评估建议：The candidate (0.8 M NaPF6, PC/EMC 1:1 v/v, 2 wt% FEC) matches the literature's preferred carbonate electrolyte for NFM/hard-carbon pouch cells, which is directly demonstrated at -20 C (~81.9-82.95% retention), so a structured recommendation is warranted; the 0.5 C rate and the exact 2.0-4.0 V window are not reported and the -20 C value's solvent ratio is ambiguous, so these gaps are noted but do not overturn the supported low-temperature suitability.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- NaPF6 as the salt：The paper uses NaPF6 as the solute for the carbonate electrolytes under study. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]
- 0.8 M salt concentration：The highest conductivity in the binary PC/EMC system is reported at 0.8 M NaPF6, and the optimized PC/EMC electrolyte is stated as 0.8 M NaPF6. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec9]
- PC/EMC binary solvent system：PC/EMC is selected as the preferred solvent system and used in the pouch-cell evaluations. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]
- PC:EMC 1:1 (v/v) ratio：The paper explicitly names PC/EMC (1/1, v/v) as the base electrolyte that previously gave excellent cycling, and the binary PC/EMC (1:1, v/v) system is the one in which the 0.8 M optimum is reported. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]
- 2 wt% FEC additive：Five 0.8 M NaPF6 electrolytes were prepared using 2 wt% FEC additive in the listed mixed solvents, which includes the PC/EMC variant. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1]
- NNFM111 (NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2)/hard-carbon pouch full cell：The NFM cathode (NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2) and hard-carbon anode are assembled into pouch cells in this work. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec4][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec2::child0]
- -20 C low-temperature operation：The pouch cell with PC/EMC electrolyte is reported to retain 81.9% (and, for the 1 M variant, 82.95%) of room-temperature capacity at -20 C. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5]
- 1 C discharge rate data：Cells are reported to deliver about 750 mAh at 1 C, and 1 C is also used in cycling and rate-capability measurements. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child5]
- 0.5 C discharge rate data：The reported rate points are 0.2 C and 1 C; no 0.5 C discharge data for this candidate/system are given in the sources. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4]
- 2.0-4.0 V operating voltage window：The sources discuss electrolyte electrochemical-window stability (e.g., side reactions between 4.0 and 4.5 V and PC stability to ~4.2 V), not a 2.0-4.0 V cell operating window, so the specific target window is not established. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4]
文献与候选的关联：The paper prepared 0.8 M NaPF6 carbonate electrolytes with 2 wt% FEC and assembled them into NFM (NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2)/hard-carbon pouch cells, measuring capacity (about 880 mAh at 0.2 C and 750 mAh at 1 C) and low-temperature capacity retention, where the PC/EMC electrolyte retained ~81.9% at -20 C. This directly links the salt, solvent family, additive and full-cell format to the low-temperature result, but the five-electrolyte solvent comparison used a 2:3 cyclic/linear carbonate ratio, so the exact ratio behind the reported -20 C number is ambiguous relative to the candidate's 1:1 PC/EMC ratio; the 1:1 PC/EMC is separately identified as the preferred base system. [0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child4][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec8::child1][0005_Che 等 - 2021 - Engineering optimization approach of nonaqueous electrolyte for sodium ion battery with long cycle l::sec4]
### c4-cie-g2-mo
评估建议：The candidate exactly matches the literature CIE formulation and is demonstrated in the target NNFM111||hard-carbon Ah-level pouch cell at -20 C (94.1% retention/300 cycles), so it is a scientifically well-supported choice; the specific 0.5 C/1 C rates and 2.0-4.0 V window remain to be confirmed experimentally rather than refuting the candidate.
任务要求与已有依据（模型语义判断，程序核验出处）：
- Electrolyte identity: 0.8 M NaPF6 dissolved in G2:MO = 7:3 vol% (the candidate's exact salt/solvent/ratio/concentration)：The Materials section defines the co-intercalated electrolyte (CIE) as 0.8 M NaPF6 in G2:MO = 7:3 vol%, which is chemically identical to the candidate. [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec7::child0][0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec7]
- Target full cell: NNFM111 (O3-NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2) cathode paired with hard carbon anode in an Ah-level pouch cell：The pouch cell is stated to use O3-type NFM (NaNi1/3Fe1/3Mn1/3O2) positive and HC negative electrodes, matching the NNFM111||hard-carbon target chemistry and format. [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec6::child0][0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec1::child4]
- Operation at -20 C in the pouch full cell：Fig. 6d reports the CIE-based NFM||HC pouch cell cycling at -20 C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles, directly confirming this temperature for the candidate in the target format. [0033_Li 等 - 2026 - Enhanced sodium storage in hard carbon via solvent co-intercalation electrolyte enabling Ah-level po::sec6::child0]
- Target discharge rates of 0.5 C and 1 C at -20 C：Rate data at low temperature are reported for HC in a Na||HC half cell (Fig. 3b) in A g^-1 terms, and the pouch cell section reports temperature-dependent capacity/retention but not 0.5 C or 1 C discharge at -20 C; no C-rate-resolved pouch data are given. 
- Target voltage window of 2.0-4.0 V for the pouch cell：None of the provided chunks state the voltage cut-off window used for the NFM||HC pouch cell, so the 2.0-4.0 V target cannot be confirmed from the supplied text. 
文献与候选的关联：The candidate's composition (0.8 M NaPF6 in G2:MO 7:3 vol%) is the same formulation the paper labels CIE, and the paper's -20 C pouch-cell cycling (Fig. 6d) uses that CIE in an NFM||HC Ah-level pouch, so the electrolyte identity and cell chemistry connect the candidate to the reported low-temperature pouch result. In this work, "blank" represents 1 M $NaPF_{6}$ , "0.1 M NaFSI" represents 0.1 M $NaFSI + 0.9 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.3 M NaFSI" represents 0.3 M $NaFSI + 0.7 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.5 M NaFSI" represents 0.5 M $NaFSI + 0.5 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.7 M NaFSI" represents 0.7 M $NaFSI + 0.3 M NaPF_{6}$ , "0.9 M NaFSI" represents 0.9 M $NaFSI + 0.1 M NaPF_{6}$ . All electrolytes were prepared in an argon-filled glove box with $H_{2}O$ and oxygen concentrations below 0.1 ppm.

source_refs.raw_quote: Firstly, the electrolyte was injected into the pouch NNFM111/HC cells in an argon-filled glove box and then the cells were deposited at room temperature for 24 h. The cells were first charged at 0.1 C constant current for 390 min with a pressure of $3 \, kg cm^{-2}$ . After charging, the cells were put at $45^{\circ}$ C for 24 h with a pressure of $3 \, kg cm^{-2}$ . All cells were activated by charging and discharging at 0.1 C, 0.2 C, 0.5 C, and 1 C. The charge and discharge tests of the NNFM111/HC full cells were conducted using a battery test system (CT-3008 W, Neware, China) at a voltage range of 2.0-4.0 V. The cycle performance of NNFM111/HC full cells was measured at a constant temperature of $25^{\circ}$ C and $45^{\circ}$ C with a charge and discharge current of 1 C. The discharge curves of the NNFM111/HC full cells at $-20^{\circ}$ C were measured in a temperature controlled test chamber at the discharge rates of 0.5 C and 1 C. The ratio of the discharge capacity of the cell at $-20^{\circ}$ C to the last discharge capacity of the cell activated at room temperature was taken as the capacity retention rate of the cell at low temperature. The cells with 50% state of charge (SOC) discharged at a current rate of 2 C for 10 s at $-20^{\circ}$ C. The direct current resistance (DCR) was calculated on the basis of Ohm's law (R=U/I).

Compared with the single-salt system, the discharge capacity of 0.5 C and 1 C of the batteries with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system increased by 23.9% and 26.8%, respectively. The results of DCR test at $-20^{\circ}C$ shows (Figure S9d) that the DCR value of the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system is significantly reduced, which is the key reason why it can release more capacity at low temperatures. Especially at the high current density, the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI can maintain a discharge capacity about 200 mAh, while the discharge capacity of the battery with single-salt system is around 0 mAh.

source_refs.raw_quote: The sodium hexafluorophosphate (NaPF $_6$ , 99.8% min), diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (G2, 99.8% min) and 2-methyloxolane (MO, 99.8% min) were purchased from DoDo Chem. Common ether electrolyte (CCE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in G2 solvent. Weakly solvated electrolyte (WSE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in MO solvent. Co-intercalated electrolyte (CIE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in G2: MO = 7:3 vol%. All electrolyte preparation processes were carried out in a glovebox filled with Ar (H $_2$ O < 0.1 ppm and O $_2$ < 0.1 ppm). The electrolyte salts and solvents we purchased are of anhydrous grade. After purchase, they are placed in the glove box for direct use. Hard carbon (HC) materials were purchased from Baisige New Energy Co., Ltd. The HC negative electrode was prepared by mixing the active material, CMC (CMC2200, purchased from Daicel Corporation), SBR (BM-451B, purchased from Zeon Corporation) and conductive carbon black (weight ratio 92:1.5:3.5:3) in deionized water to form a homogeneous slurry. The slurry was spread on a copper foil (thickness 18 $\mu$ m) and dried at 80 °C for 8–12 h. Then, it was perforated into a circular electrode sheet with a diameter of 12 mm and a loading of 2.5–3.0 mg cm $^{-2}$ . Glass fiber (GF/D, Whatman) was used as separator and metallic sodium (purchased from Canrd Technology Co. Ltd.) was used as counter electrode.

source_refs.raw_quote: To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments.

While CIE maintains a high ionic conductivity at low temperatures and is always higher than that of WSE. Therefore, compared to the WSE, the CIE designed here can effectively solve the decrease in ionic conductivity and promote ion transport at low temperatures. In addition, we also tested the physical parameters of different electrolytes, such as the electrochemical window and transference number (Figs. S5, S6). Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations were carried out to further investigate the solvation structure of the electrolyte under different temperature gradients. The radial distribution functions (RDF) of different electrolytes are shown in Fig. 2e,f and S7-8. In CCE, the average coordination number of G2 is 1.60 and that of PF $_{6}^{-}$ is 0.87. While in CIE, the coordination number of G2 decreases to 1.41, the coordination number of PF $_{6}^{-}$ increases to 1.10, and that of MO is 0.11. This is attributed to the introduction of MO which has a dipole interaction with G2, slightly weakening the coordination of G2 and Na $^{+}$ . In addition, MO hardly coordinates with Na $^{+}$ , which is consistent with the results of Raman and FTIR. In WSE, the average coordination number of MO is 0.93 and PF $_{6}^{-}$ is 3.05, constituting a typical aggregate-type (AGG) solvation structure rich in anions.

4 Conclusions
In summary, we have systematically studied carbonate-based electrolytes for NFM/HC SIBs, showing that PC-based electrolytes outperform in terms of capacity retention and safety, as compared with the EC-based electrolytes. Combined with multiple additives, the PC/EMC electrolyte further promotes the formation of a protective interfacial layer, which consequently mitigates parasitic reactions between the electrodes and electrolyte and suppresses chemical dissolution of transition metal ions from the desodiated (charged) NFM. Finally, we demonstrated that a 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ /PC-EMC optimized by the second-generation additives not only enables the NFM/HC pouch cell to reversibly cycle over 2500 cycles but also makes the cell safer.

The NFM cathode and hard carbon (HC) anode were prepared by coating slurries consisting of 92 wt.% active material, 4 wt.% super P, and 4 wt.% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) in N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) onto an aluminum foil, respectively. The cathode-separator-anode assembles were stacked and packaged into a plastic-laminated aluminum pouch. After heating at 80 °C for 48 h under vacuum, the dried pouch cells were moved into a glove box for injecting electrolyte.

source_refs.raw_quote: Electrolyte design strategies are closely related to the capacities, cycle life and safety of sodium-ion batteries. In this study, we are aimed to optimize electrolyte with the focus on engineering aspects. The basic physicochemical properties including ionic conductivity, viscosity, wettability and thermochemical stability of the electrolytes using $\mathrm{NaPF}_6$ as the solute and the mixed solvent with different components of EMC, DMC or DEC in PC or EC were systematically measured. Ah pouch cell with $\mathrm{NaNi}_{1/3}\mathrm{Fe}_{1/3}\mathrm{Mn}_{1/3}\mathrm{O}_2/$ hard carbon electrodes was used to evaluate the performance of the prepared electrolytes. By using the Inductive Coupled Plasma Emission Spectrometer (ICP), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), Thermogravimetric-differential scanning calorimetry (TG-DSC) and Accelerating Rate Calorimeter (ARC), we show that an optimized electrolyte can effectively promote the formation of a protective interfacial layer on two electrodes, which not only retards parasitic reactions between the electrodes and electrolyte but also suppresses dissolution of metal ions from the cathode. With an optimized electrolyte, a $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ /hard carbon cell can attain 56.16% capacity retention under the low temperature of -40 °C, and can be able to retain 80% capacity retention after more than 2500 cycles while presenting excellent thermal safety.

Materials
The sodium hexafluorophosphate (NaPF $_6$ , 99.8% min), diethylene glycol dimethyl ether (G2, 99.8% min) and 2-methyloxolane (MO, 99.8% min) were purchased from DoDo Chem. Common ether electrolyte (CCE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in G2 solvent. Weakly solvated electrolyte (WSE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in MO solvent. Co-intercalated electrolyte (CIE) was prepared by dissolving 0.8 M NaPF $_6$ in G2: MO = 7:3 vol%. All electrolyte preparation processes were carried out in a glovebox filled with Ar (H $_2$ O < 0.1 ppm and O $_2$ < 0.1 ppm). The electrolyte salts and solvents we purchased are of anhydrous grade. After purchase, they are placed in the glove box for direct use.

Hard carbon (HC) materials were purchased from Baisige New Energy Co., Ltd. The HC negative electrode was prepared by mixing the active material, CMC (CMC2200, purchased from Daicel Corporation), SBR (BM-451B, purchased from Zeon Corporation) and conductive carbon black (weight ratio 92:1.5:3.5:3) in deionized water to form a homogeneous slurry. The slurry was spread on a copper foil (thickness 18 $\mu$ m) and dried at 80 °C for 8–12 h. Then, it was perforated into a circular electrode sheet with a diameter of 12 mm and a loading of 2.5–3.0 mg cm $^{-2}$ . Glass fiber (GF/D, Whatman) was used as separator and metallic sodium (purchased from Canrd Technology Co. Ltd.) was used as counter electrode. These components were assembled with HC negative electrode to assemble Na ||HC coin cells. The diameter of the glass fiber is 16 mm and the thickness is 0.68 mm. The diameter of the sodium metal electrode is 15.6 mm and the thickness is 0.4 mm.

The Ah-level pouch batteries were composed of O3-NaNi $_{1/3}$ Fe $_{1/3}$ Mn $_{1/3}$ O $_{2}$ (NFM) positive electrode and HC negative electrode coated on Al foil. The specific details and parameters are shown in Table S7.

citations.quote: Firstly, the electrolyte was injected into the pouch NNFM111/HC cells in an argon-filled glove box and then the cells were deposited at room temperature for 24 h. The cells were first charged at 0.1 C constant current for 390 min with a pressure of $3 \, kg cm^{-2}$ . After charging, the cells were put at $45^{\circ}$ C for 24 h with a pressure of $3 \, kg cm^{-2}$ . All cells were activated by charging and discharging at 0.1 C, 0.2 C, 0.5 C, and 1 C. The charge and discharge tests of the NNFM111/HC full cells were conducted using a battery test system (CT-3008 W, Neware, China) at a voltage range of 2.0-4.0 V. The cycle performance of NNFM111/HC full cells was measured at a constant temperature of $25^{\circ}$ C and $45^{\circ}$ C with a charge and discharge current of 1 C. The discharge curves of the NNFM111/HC full cells at $-20^{\circ}$ C were measured in a temperature controlled test chamber at the discharge rates of 0.5 C and 1 C. The ratio of the discharge capacity of the cell at $-20^{\circ}$ C to the last discharge capacity of the cell activated at room temperature was taken as the capacity retention rate of the cell at low temperature. The cells with 50% state of charge (SOC) discharged at a current rate of 2 C for 10 s at $-20^{\circ}$ C. The direct current resistance (DCR) was calculated on the basis of Ohm's law (R=U/I).

citations.quote:
4 Conclusions
In summary, we have systematically studied carbonate-based electrolytes for NFM/HC SIBs, showing that PC-based electrolytes outperform in terms of capacity retention and safety, as compared with the EC-based electrolytes. Combined with multiple additives, the PC/EMC electrolyte further promotes the formation of a protective interfacial layer, which consequently mitigates parasitic reactions between the electrodes and electrolyte and suppresses chemical dissolution of transition metal ions from the desodiated (charged) NFM. Finally, we demonstrated that a 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ /PC-EMC optimized by the second-generation additives not only enables the NFM/HC pouch cell to reversibly cycle over 2500 cycles but also makes the cell safer.

citations.quote:
2.1 Electrolyte and pouch cell preparation
Battery grade solvents of propylene carbonate (PC), ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), diethyl carbonate (DEC) and fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) were obtained from Shenzhen CAPCHEM Technology Co., Ltd, China, and used as received. Sodium hexafluorophosphate $(\mathrm{NaPF}_6$ , KISHIDA Chemical Co., Ltd, Japan) was dissolved into cold solvent mixtures with different volume ratios. Water contents of all resultant electrolytes were determined by the Karl Fischer titration to be lower than $15~\mathrm{ppm}$ .

The $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ (NFM) cathode material was scale-up synthesized as described previously [17]. The NFM cathode and hard carbon (HC) anode were prepared by coating slurries consisting of 92 wt.% active material, 4 wt.% super P, and 4 wt.% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) in N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) onto an aluminum foil, respectively. The cathode-separator-anode assembles were stacked and packaged into a plastic-laminated aluminum pouch. After heating at 80 °C for 48 h under vacuum, the dried pouch cells were moved into a glove box for injecting electrolyte.

citations.quote: Electrolyte design strategies are closely related to the capacities, cycle life and safety of sodium-ion batteries. In this study, we are aimed to optimize electrolyte with the focus on engineering aspects. The basic physicochemical properties including ionic conductivity, viscosity, wettability and thermochemical stability of the electrolytes using $\mathrm{NaPF}_6$ as the solute and the mixed solvent with different components of EMC, DMC or DEC in PC or EC were systematically measured. Ah pouch cell with $\mathrm{NaNi}_{1/3}\mathrm{Fe}_{1/3}\mathrm{Mn}_{1/3}\mathrm{O}_2/$ hard carbon electrodes was used to evaluate the performance of the prepared electrolytes. By using the Inductive Coupled Plasma Emission Spectrometer (ICP), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), Thermogravimetric-differential scanning calorimetry (TG-DSC) and Accelerating Rate Calorimeter (ARC), we show that an optimized electrolyte can effectively promote the formation of a protective interfacial layer on two electrodes, which not only retards parasitic reactions between the electrodes and electrolyte but also suppresses dissolution of metal ions from the cathode. With an optimized electrolyte, a $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ /hard carbon cell can attain 56.16% capacity retention under the low temperature of -40 °C, and can be able to retain 80% capacity retention after more than 2500 cycles while presenting excellent thermal safety.

association_citations.quote: Therefore, in the present work, the PC/EMC solvent system was preferably selected to investigate the effect of solvent ratio and salt concentration. In the binary PC/EMC (1:1, v/v) system, the highest conductivity of 7.45 mS cm $^{-1}$ at 20 °C is observed at 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ (Fig. 1b). It is also found that the conductivity of electrolyte changes with the solvent ratio changing. The viscosity of 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ electrolyte is gradually increased with the PC content rising. With an increase in the PC content, the conductivity increases markedly in the range lower than 40%, reaches a maximum at 60% (i.e., PC/EMC=3/2), and inversely declines in the range higher than 60% (Fig. 1c). On the other hand, the electrolytes with PC content lower than 40% are much easier to wet the nonpolar polypropylene-polyethylene separator. Complete wetting of the separator typically takes no more than 10 seconds, as indicated by the wetting angles and wettability in Fig. S1 and Fig. S2. Based on the above results, five 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ electrolytes were prepared by using 2 wt% FEC additive and PC/EMC, PC/DMC, EC/EMC, EC/DMC and EC/DEC mixed solvents (all having a 2:3 cyclic/linear carbonate ratio), respectively. It is shown that the ionic conductivity of these electrolytes is increased in the order of EC/DMC > PC/DMC > EC/EMC > PC/EMC > EC/DEC, whereas the viscosity is changed nearly in an opposite order of EC/DEC > EC/EMC > PC/EMC > PC/DMC ≈ EC/DMC (Fig. 2a).

citations.quote: To verify the practical applicability of CIE, we assembled a 1.2 Ah (163 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ) pouch cell with O3-type NFM positive electrode and HC negative electrode (Fig. 6a). Figure 6b shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at different temperatures. At 25 °C, the pouch cell provides a capacity of 1.18 Ah. As the temperature decreases, we verify the possibility of its operation at low temperatures, at -50 °C, the pouch cell still provides a capacity of 0.79 Ah (107 Wh kg $^{-1}$ ), demonstrating a significantly better low-temperature adaptability than that of conventional electrolytes. Moreover, even at -50 °C, the charge/discharge curve maintains a stable voltage plateau (Fig. 6c). Figure 6d shows the cycling performance of the pouch cell at -20 °C with 94.1% capacity retention after 300 cycles. In addition, in order to visually verify the practical application potential, the LED lights are continuously powered at a low temperature of -50 °C. The fully-charged state pouch cells keep the LED lights working for more than 10 hours (Fig. 6e). This demonstration confirms that the CIE has good prospects for practical applications, especially at low temperatures. We further compare our results with some previously reported low-temperature sodium-ion pouch cells (Fig. 6f, Table S6) $^{26,52-58}$ , and our work is comparable to most of the advanced reported works, which fully proves that the CIE developed by us has important application value for SIBs in cold environments.

The ratio of the discharge capacity of the cell at $-20^{\circ}$ C to the last discharge capacity of the cell activated at room temperature was taken as the capacity retention rate of the cell at low temperature. The cells with 50% state of charge (SOC) discharged at a current rate of 2 C for 10 s at $-20^{\circ}$ C. The direct current resistance (DCR) was calculated on the basis of Ohm's law (R=U/I).

In summary, we have systematically studied carbonate-based electrolytes for NFM/HC SIBs, showing that PC-based electrolytes outperform in terms of capacity retention and safety, as compared with the EC-based electrolytes. Battery grade solvents of propylene carbonate (PC), ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), dimethyl carbonate (DMC), diethyl carbonate (DEC) and fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) were obtained from Shenzhen CAPCHEM Technology Co., Ltd, China, and used as received. The $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ (NFM) cathode material was scale-up synthesized as described previously [17]. The NFM cathode and hard carbon (HC) anode were prepared by coating slurries consisting of 92 wt.% active material, 4 wt.% super P, and 4 wt.% polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF) in N-Methyl-2-pyrrolidone (NMP) onto an aluminum foil, respectively. evidence_ledger.quote: Electrolyte design strategies are closely related to the capacities, cycle life and safety of sodium-ion batteries. In this study, we are aimed to optimize electrolyte with the focus on engineering aspects. The basic physicochemical properties including ionic conductivity, viscosity, wettability and thermochemical stability of the electrolytes using $\mathrm{NaPF}_6$ as the solute and the mixed solvent with different components of EMC, DMC or DEC in PC or EC were systematically measured. Ah pouch cell with $\mathrm{NaNi}_{1/3}\mathrm{Fe}_{1/3}\mathrm{Mn}_{1/3}\mathrm{O}_2/$ hard carbon electrodes was used to evaluate the performance of the prepared electrolytes. By using the Inductive Coupled Plasma Emission Spectrometer (ICP), X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), Thermogravimetric-differential scanning calorimetry (TG-DSC) and Accelerating Rate Calorimeter (ARC), we show that an optimized electrolyte can effectively promote the formation of a protective interfacial layer on two electrodes, which not only retards parasitic reactions between the electrodes and electrolyte but also suppresses dissolution of metal ions from the cathode. With an optimized electrolyte, a $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}$ /hard carbon cell can attain 56.16% capacity retention under the low temperature of -40 °C, and can be able to retain 80% capacity retention after more than 2500 cycles while presenting excellent thermal safety.

citations.quote:
A Sodium Bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (NaFSI)-based Multifunctional Electrolyte Stabilizes the Performance of $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}/hard\ Carbon\ Sodium-ion\ Batteries$
Weizhen Fan, $^{[a, b]}$ Wenlian Wang, $^{[a, b]}$ Qixing Xie, $^{[b]}$ Xin He, $^{[a]}$ Haijia Li, $^{[a]}$ Jingwei Zhao, $^{[b]}$ and Junmin Nan $^{*[a]}$

A sodium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide (NaFSI)-based multifunctional electrolyte is developed by partially replacing $NaPF_{6}$ salt in the electrolyte to improve the wide temperature range working capability of $NaNi_{1/3}Fe_{1/3}Mn_{1/3}O_{2}/hard$ carbon (NNFM111/HC) sodium-ion batteries (SIBs). The capacity retention of the SIBs with NaFSI- $NaPF_{6}$ dual salt electrolyte increases from 47.2% to 75.5% after 250 cycles at 25°C, and from 51.0% to 82.3% after 80 cycles at 45°C, and the 1 C discharge capacity retention at the low temperature of -20°C also increases 26.8%. citations.quote: At the same time, the production of a large amount of gas also means that the side reaction inside the battery is very serious, and a large amount of electrolyte components decompose to produce gas. The thickness change of the 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system battery is only 3.4%. At the same time, the growth of impedance, especially DCR, is suppressed and the calendar aging performance is improved. It is worth noting that after extending the storage time, the performance of the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system is still better than that of the single-salt system, but the gap between the two is significantly reduced, indicating that the NaFSI effect is gradually weakened. The impedance spectrum of the battery during storage (Figure 6d–f and Table S4) is also consistent with its performance changes. The introduction of NaFSI not only reduces the impedance of the battery, but also effectively suppresses the internal side reactions of the battery, resulting in the impedance growth of the battery with 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system is significantly lower than that of the single-salt system. In addition, the significant reduction in the impedance of the 0.5 M NaFSI double-salt system means that the harmful components caused by side reactions are reduced. citations.quote:
4 Conclusions
In summary, we have systematically studied carbonate-based electrolytes for NFM/HC SIBs, showing that PC-based electrolytes outperform in terms of capacity retention and safety, as compared with the EC-based electrolytes. Combined with multiple additives, the PC/EMC electrolyte further promotes the formation of a protective interfacial layer, which consequently mitigates parasitic reactions between the electrodes and electrolyte and suppresses chemical dissolution of transition metal ions from the desodiated (charged) NFM. Finally, we demonstrated that a 0.8 M NaPF $_{6}$ /PC-EMC optimized by the second-generation additives not only enables the NFM/HC pouch cell to reversibly cycle over 2500 cycles but also makes the cell safer.
